Frontend UI: All features working correctly. Fixed 1 backend bug during testing (MongoDB _id serialization in policy report generation).

fixed_during_testing.issue: MongoDB ObjectId not serializable - _id field was being returned in response after insert_one
fixed_during_testing.fix: Added report_doc.pop('_id', None) before returning the response

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 7 Blockchain Evidence and Policy Dashboard fully tested and working. Blockchain endpoints: POST /api/evidence/secure-upload (returns file_hash, combined_hash), GET /api/evidence/{id}/verify (returns is_valid, chain_intact, court_admissible), GET /api/evidence/{id}/certificate (court-ready certificate), GET /api/blockchain/status. Policy endpoints: GET /api/policy/dashboard-data, POST /api/policy/generate-report, GET /api/policy/reports, GET /api/policy/report/{id}. All Phase 1-6 features continue to work (regression tested).

mocked_apis.blockchain: Simulated blockchain (not real distributed ledger) - uses SHA-256 hashing and local storage
mocked_apis.SOS_SMS: SOS alerts send simulated notifications (no real SMS)

mocked_apis.file_storage: Local file storage instead of S3
